title: WazirX multisig
believed: A transfer of 500,000 USDT to WazirX's withdrawal wallet, already whitelisted in Liminal's address book. All signers saw the expected token and destination in the Liminal interface; the Ledger showed neither. The card is the decoy proposal the Transaction Service holds at the same nonce, safeTxHash 0xfe1d20734698cb8f8fc21e70a797db518063bc5d059cba41d1f220cec1e4529a.
